info.title: Pandlens API (GPT Actions subset)
info.description: Trimmed OpenAPI for ChatGPT Actions: per-address GET operations plus GET /v1/usage for connection tests. Customers authenticate with the X-Api-Key header (your Pandlens API key). This file excludes batch, bulk, search, and area-wide endpoints on purpose. Full specification: https://api.pandlens.nl/swagger/v1/swagger.json . Documentation: https://pandlens.nl/docs .

get.description: Building and dwelling unit data, registered energy label and neighbourhood statistics (incl. the buurt's average WOZ value in euros, neighbourhood.gemiddeldeWozWaardeEur) for one postcode + huisnummer (optional huisletter, toevoeging). Optional include=derived,woz,energy,neighbourhood,provenance or legacy includeDerivedMetrics=true; includeGeometry (default false) and includeHistory (default false). Default response excludes derived intelligence and building footprint GeoJSON. Counts as one lookup. Repeat lookups of the same address within 24 hours are served from cache and not billed.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests per minute for this API key.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Remaining requests in the current one-minute window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the current window resets.

404.description: Address not found (`address_not_found`) or ambiguous (`address_ambiguous` with `candidates`: huisletter, toevoeging).
